A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the closing of a consultation can provide an important insight into how a consultation is constructed and how a consultant and writer relate to each other.
writing center consultation closings are not just a matter of saying goodbye, but rather are an important opportunity to reflect on and to reframe the nature of our interactions with students.
the closing of a writing consultation is a complex, multi-layered process, and it deserves more attention from writing center scholars and consultants.

writing center consultations are not necessarily the same as other kinds of consultations. They are more than service encounters and
